settings.showPetDesc: When off, the pet window is hidden and stays hidden on next launch.
settings.alwaysOnTopDesc: When on, the pet floats above other windows; when off, it can be covered like a normal window.
settings.developerDesc: Used to distinguish the pet window bounds from the actual video display area.
settings.debugFrameDesc: Show the window bounds and video area bounds, and display the live window and video sizes inside the pet window.

decoration.sectionDescription: Currently only shows available decoration materials; actual decoration logic can be connected later.

bubble.sectionDescription: Choose the desktop pet speech bubble style. Each style can define its own background, dimensions, and decoration placement.
bubble.styleDescription: The selected style is applied to the pet window immediately.
